service_configuration_and_state:
# /usr/lib/systemd/system/xochitl.service
[Unit]
Description=reMarkable main application
StartLimitIntervalSec=600
StartLimitBurst=4
OnFailure=remarkable-fail.service
DefaultDependencies=no
Conflicts=shutdown.target
Before=shutdown.target
Wants=rm-sync.service
After=data.mount dbus.socket
Requires=dbus.socket

[Service]
ExecStart=/usr/bin/xochitl --system
Restart=on-failure
WatchdogSec=60
NotifyAccess=all

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

# /etc/systemd/system/xochitl.service.d/00-xovi.conf
[Service]
Environment="LD_PRELOAD=/home/root/xovi/xovi.so"
Environment="XOVI_ROOT=/home/root/xovi/services/xochitl.service/"

# /etc/systemd/system/xochitl.service.d/50-computed-widgets-01-preflight.conf
[Unit]
RequiresMountsFor=/home
[Service]
ExecStartPre=/usr/local/libexec/computed-widgets-01-target preflight

# /etc/systemd/system/xochitl.service.d/qt-resource-rebuilder.conf
[Service]
Environment="QML_DISABLE_DISK_CACHE=1"
Environment="QML_XHR_ALLOW_FILE_WRITE=1"
Environment="QML_XHR_ALLOW_FILE_READ=1"

# /usr/lib/systemd/system/xochitl.service.d/xochitl-service-override.conf
[Unit]
Requires=dev-dri-card0.device
After=dev-dri-card0.device tee-supplicant.service
Wants=tee-supplicant.service
JobTimeoutSec=60s
OnFailure=emergency.target

[Service]
Environment="MALLOC_ARENA_MAX=8"
RestartMode=direct
Environment=LD_PRELOAD=/home/root/xovi/xovi.so XOVI_ROOT=/home/root/xovi/services/xochitl.service/ QML_DISABLE_DISK_CACHE=1 QML_XHR_ALLOW_FILE_WRITE=1 QML_XHR_ALLOW_FILE_READ=1 MALLOC_ARENA_MAX=8
FragmentPath=/usr/lib/systemd/system/xochitl.service
DropInPaths=/etc/systemd/system/xochitl.service.d/00-xovi.conf /etc/systemd/system/xochitl.service.d/50-computed-widgets-01-preflight.conf /etc/systemd/system/xochitl.service.d/qt-resource-rebuilder.conf /usr/lib/systemd/system/xochitl.service.d/xochitl-service-override.conf

comparison_rule: Compare byte-identical service configuration and stock/loader/other-extension hashes. Compare normalized LISTEN addresses separately; dynamic inode/connection rows are not restoration identity.
known_prior_baseline_difference: Current webserver-remote.so replaces historical fix-ebook-links.so in active extension inventory. Do not repair historical state or change unrelated extensions.
